title: Kanban board with drag and keyboard moves
when: The user wants a kanban or task board with columns and cards that move by drag and drop and by keyboard, saved locally.
prompt:
Goal: A board where cards move between and within columns by pointer or keyboard, and the exact order survives a reload.
Steps:
1. State { columns: [{ id, title }], cards: [{ id, columnId, title, order }] }; column ids like backlog, doing, done.
2. logic.mjs: addCard, moveCard(state, cardId, toColumn, toIndex) renumbering order in both columns, renameCard, deleteCard, cardsIn(state, columnId).
3. Each column is a section with an h2 and a ul; each card an li with draggable="true", tabindex="0" and a menu button.
4. Drag: dragstart puts the card id in dataTransfer, dragover calls preventDefault and finds the drop index from pointer y against card midpoints, drop calls moveCard.
5. Keyboard: Alt+ArrowLeft/Right changes column, Alt+ArrowUp/Down reorders; keep focus on the card and announce "Moved to Doing, position 2" in aria-live.
6. Per column add form with a labeled input; save state to localStorage board.v1 in try and catch.
7. test.mjs: cross column move, reorder, order stays 0 to n-1, delete.
Quality bar:
- Moves are possible without a mouse.
- Columns stack vertically under 640 px.
- Dragged card shows a clear drop marker.
Pitfalls:
- Moving the DOM node without updating state.
- Drops that only work on empty space, not between cards.
- Drag as the only way to move.
Verify:
- [ ] Drag works across and within columns.
- [ ] Keyboard moves keep focus on the card.
- [ ] Moves are announced.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (render, drag, keys), logic.mjs (board state), test.mjs.

examples.input: a kanban board for my freelance projects
examples.output: columns Backlog/Doing/Done, draggable cards, Alt+arrows to move, board.v1 saved
